policy.evidence_rule: Observed learner evidence and inferred mastery are distinct records. Inferred mastery cannot masquerade as source evidence.
policy.planning_rule: Instruction is planned against an explicit objective DAG; unmet or uncertain prerequisites are handled before advancing the target.
policy.outcome_rule: Pedagogy is evaluated by independently owned learning outcomes, score change, retained performance, and misconception correction. Engagement alone is never a promotion criterion.

objectives.description: Distinguish observed evidence from inference and unsupported claims.
Form conclusions whose strength is calibrated to the available evidence.
Test a proposed conclusion against counterexamples and boundary cases.
